'''Devit''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], who lived on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] scenario ''[[Looking In: The Air Up Thaere|The Air Up Thaere]]'', it is possible for the player characters to purchase a [[residency pin]] from Devit, for 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|dataries]]. The scenario does not reveal Devit's [[Gender/Legends|gender]].
